suggestion.title: Create Natural Curves
suggestion.body: To add dimension to your balanced shape, try using belts to cinch the waist, or wear layered outfits and ruched dresses to create the illusion of flowing curves.

suggestion.title: Broaden the Shoulders
suggestion.body: To add dimension to your straight torso, try layering with structured jackets like blazers or overshirts. A tailored shirt tucked into slim-straight trousers will give you a sharp, defined look.

characteristics: Bust and hips are about the same range

recommended_items.advice: Wrap dresses create the illusion of a defined waist on a straight silhouette.
X-line dresses, fitted through the waist and flaring at the hem, create curves a straight silhouette doesn't naturally have.
Shift dresses skim your straight line for a clean, effortless silhouette.
Empire-waist dresses set a defined waistline higher up, adding shape to a straight torso.
A-line dresses flare from the waist, adding the illusion of curves to a straight frame.
Fit-and-flare dresses cinch at the waist and flare out, creating curves your straight silhouette doesn't have on its own.
One-shoulder dresses add asymmetry and visual interest to a straight silhouette.
Slim, straight-leg jeans keep your straight silhouette clean without adding bulk.
Straight-leg jeans follow your naturally straight line for an effortless, elongated look.
Bootcut jeans gently flare below the knee, creating the illusion of curves along a straight frame.
Wide-leg jeans add volume and movement, balancing a straight torso with a fuller silhouette below.

general_advice: Trouser-style detailing -- front pleats, a tailored waistband -- adds structure and definition to a straight silhouette.

recommended_items.advice: A fitted cut creates definition along your straight silhouette instead of skimming past it.
A classic, structured shirt keeps clean lines that suit your straight frame.

avoid_items.advice: An oversized shirt can hide the shape you already have -- a fitted or classic cut works harder for you.

recommended_items.advice: A snug fit shows off your straight, lean line.
